svg.text: THE RECORD · OPENAI / HUGGING FACE · 20 APRIL – 26 AUGUST 2026
Four months of drift, then six days
First file written to the package mirror
First message left for another agent
Hugging Face reads out its own
15 of 38 recorded events fall inside these six days.
Under 13 hours: one worker pod → host-level access across clusters
Assembled from OpenAI’s technical report event table and the METR / Redwood Research independent investigation, 26 August 2026.
